sections.value:
PASS WITH NOTES -- #240, round 2 (final under C34)
Head: 520e5d196305eb61a668bba93257719f0095272f
Answers: 01a1ecb9-ea3f-7bf1-b3f9-60eb81adf1a2
Scope: only 69c0516d8879793b1776753e6d75839931608ce0..520e5d196305eb61a668bba93257719f0095272f.

No performance blocker or demonstrated normal-use false negative found.
S240-001's nearest-host boundary stops at unregistered nested Copilot B,
rather than accepting registered ancestor A. Ordinary shell wrappers are
passed over. The final Linux addition strips one trailing " (deleted)"
before taking the executable basename, matching registration's convention;
this avoids climbing past an upgraded host. No product files were edited,
and no local build or test was run.

Delta cost

The existing cadence is one scheduled render per 10 seconds per rendering
Copilot session, PLUS event-triggered renders; it is not a hard rate cap.
There is no new timer, poll, daemon RPC or process launch. The same one
whoami request remains. This means ZERO added launches, not zero total
process creation by the pre-existing shell/CLI hook.

macOS: the old parent_pid already called parent_and_name, allocating a
name and then discarding it. parent_and_host_name reuses that same
ProcBSDShortInfo read. The new walk keeps/compares the name and reads the
candidate host as well. A direct-child accepted render changes from one
parent/process observation plus one start read to TWO process observations
plus one start read: one extra short-BSD-info call and small name String.
Foreign/nested candidates now stop at the nearer host instead of walking
to an outer seat. Each name comparison checks at most eight short names.

Linux: each observation reads /proc/PID/stat and additionally readlinks
/proc/PID/exe, then extracts a name. The direct-child case has two such
observations instead of one stat-only parent read, plus the same matching
start read. linux_exe_name adds only a suffix check, basename extraction
and String construction; no extra file read or subprocess.

The exact new ceiling is ONE pre-loop observation of self plus up to
64 ancestor observations = 65 process-reader calls, and at most one start
read. The "at most 64 processes" wording is off by that initial read.
On the common macOS direct-child path the scheduled incremental cost is
approximately C/10 extra short-BSD-info reads/s for C rendering sessions,
plus event-triggered work. Wrapper depth scales linearly; no census or
per-seat daemon work is introduced. main.rs passes observed_start directly,
so no unreadable-process path falls through to the ps liveness adapter.
The existing git fallback is unchanged.

State/list/cards production code, renewal loops and spawn_sites.rs are
unchanged from round 1. The native diagnostic delta is test assertions
only. This verdict does not reopen those unchanged cost paths.

Normal-use launch and identity check

Registration verifies the actual native host pid/start, not the npm loader
or extension child (registration.rs:692-773,1969-1987).
The extension starts its resolution at process.ppid, selects the Copilot
ancestor, confirms its identity, and records that host
(.copilot/extensions/pij/extension.mjs:189-194; store.mjs:2512-2548).
The daemon also accepts the node + @github/copilot/index.js host form;
HOST_NAMES includes node. A distinct intervening Node helper would stop
this new walk, but no such normal-use launch was established.

I independently observed the running native seat: whoami recorded pid
50552, start 20261118131332; exact-pid OS metadata reported p_comm=copilot,
parent 50551, and executable basename copilot. Thus its recorded process
is the actual native host, not its launcher.

Read-only observation, 2026-11-18 03:45:36.003720Z to 03:46:01.005827Z:
25.001850 seconds, 4054 polls, only that exact host's descendants, bounded
to three levels and 64 visited children per poll. Seven pij-rs children
were seen, all directly parented by host 50552. In particular pid 57393
was seen as sh/bash and then pij-rs at 03:45:43.480794Z, and pid 58778
made the same transition at 03:45:53.480633Z. These are same-pid exec
transitions, with no intermediate node host. Their ten-second spacing is
consistent with the configured statusline refresh and the author's
earlier direct-parent capture. Only names/parent links were collected,
not argv or environments; do not infer a command census or every CLI
distribution's behavior from this sample. The managed script execs
pij-rs, so both a direct launch and retained ordinary shell wrappers
resolve to the observed Copilot host.

All eight recognized host names fit inside macOS's 15-character p_comm
payload, so truncation does not truncate these names. The macOS branch
continues to use the existing typed ProcBSDShortInfo reader and pid check.
No new macOS-only compile issue was found by source inspection; this
review did not locally compile that branch.

Proof

just pr-freeze 240: FINAL at the full head above, clean detached worktree,
main base, latest delivers and all four CI jobs passing. The earlier
cancelled delivers run is superseded by a successful latest run.
CI run 44231858379 is SUCCESS at this exact head. Its successful rust-test
job 134558560135 uploaded artifact ID 14395228809. I inspected that exact
2474-case JUnit artifact: PASS for the nested-Copilot boundary, host-reader,
foreign-seat, Linux deleted-suffix, lease expiry/recovery, and never-renewed
boot-grace regressions; launch-accounting, absolute ps/date, resolved
git/tmux and retired-launch guards also PASS. CI is Linux-only.
The synthetic nested-host test covers direct and shell-wrapped B, both
identity paths, B's own seat and A's own render. It is not a fixture for
an arbitrary different Node helper, nor is such a fixture a C34 merge gate.

Notes and owed proof

1. AFTER-BOUNCE performance measurement remains OWED after merge, binary
   install and daemon bounce: two same-PID ping spawn-counter readings
   across a known interval, just spawn-rate --seconds 20, and daemon
   CPU/RSS on a comparable fleet. Compare within-window rates, never
   absolute counters across restarted daemon PIDs. The prior baseline
   remains 03:15:32.321241Z..03:15:52.506222Z, PID 46800, total 793 -> 793
   over 20.184645 seconds (0 daemon launches/s), machine 111.9 launches/s.
   The host observation above is not a deployment/after measurement.
2. C34 follow-up: correct the cost-bound wording to self plus 64 ancestors
   (65 reader calls). This documentation correction and a permanent
   bound/no-launch CLI contract are non-blocking; no normal-use cost
   breach was established. A launch-contract receipt for another CLI
   distribution would be useful if it actually introduces a distinct
   harness-named helper. Do not broaden acceptance speculatively.
